pages.text: A $(item)cracked vessel$() was my first rite, and it cost nothing. It holds 100 of whichever grief fills it first.

pages.title: Holding It
pages.text: A bound vessel holds 400, a rift vessel 1600. I pour them into the altar when I come back from the dark, and sculk itself pours in as well.$(br2)The altar held 400 of each at its first tier, 1600 at its second, 6400 at its third. What I carry in vessels I spend later, on my body and my spells.
